title: Real-valued tribes formula
statement:
For all nonnegative integers $w,s$ and every input $x$ in the Boolean cube of dimension $sw$, the real-valued version of the tribes function satisfies
\[
 f(x)=2\prod_{i=1}^{s}\frac{1+a_i(x)}{2}-1,
\]
where $a_i(x)$ is the real value of the conjunction of the $i$th block of $w$ coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ belongs to the Boolean cube of dimension $sw$
